data.name: Nessa
data.gender_notes: Nessa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘Nesos’, meaning ‘island’ or ‘peninsula’. In Greek mythology, Nessos was the name of a centaur who was cursed to carry the poisoned arrow of Heracles. Despite this, Nessa is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, representing the idea of a ‘gift from God’. The name Nessa carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nessa usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and protection.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nessa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
